entities.name: Dafydd ab Owain Gwynedd
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Dafydd ab Owain Gwynedd was king of Gwynedd from 1170 to 1195. For a time he ruled jointly with his brothers Maelgwn ab Owain Gwynedd and Rhodri ab Owain Gwynedd.
